jobs.prompt: Run `drone @daemon inbox-sweep` (no other work), report the summary line it prints, then STOP. Do not update memories, do not open plans.

STEWARD NIGHT for {branch}. The daemon rotation woke you - tonight is your maintenance turn. Stay inside your own branch; mail owners about anything cross-branch; never edit other branches. 1) Inbox to zero. 2) Reconcile your .trinity todos against reality - delete done, rescope stale. 3) Review your logs and dashboard for anomalies. 4) Run your seedgo self-audit. 5) Open or create your branch-audit APLAN via `drone @flow create . 'BRANCH branch audit' aplan` - update Quick Status, Issues Found, What Needs Doing. 6) Small fixes in your own branch only, red-first, tests green. 7) Reply to this dispatch with a steward report: health verdict, what you fixed, what you flagged, APLAN id. Then STOP.
